explanation: From main: script reads of published bundles go through scripts/lib/bundleReader.mts (query index, expression index, bundle optimizer, upload guards, deploy verifier, SEO study pages), listDiskCorpus is the one sweep of public/datasets, and study pages and the agent export read publication identity through scripts/lib/studyRecord.mts. From this change: the delivery catalog names the Data-origin layout and the release allow-list archives hypomap-release.json. Adding a dataset still needs only its registry entry, bundles, index rebuild and optional studySources.json snapshot; the uploader publishes the same .js bundles.
